description: This file contains a class implementing Drupal hook functions related to user theme templates, including theme registration, preprocessing user and username templates, and block preprocessing.

classes.name: Drupal\user\Hook\UserThemeHooks
classes.description: Implements theme hooks and preprocessing functions for user-related templates in Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting current user and theme settings provider.

methods.name: theme
methods.description: Defines theme hooks for user and username templates.

methods.name: preprocessUser
methods.description: Prepares variables for user templates, extracting user entity and content elements.

methods.name: preprocessUsername
methods.description: Prepares variables for username templates, including link generation and access control.

methods.name: preprocessBlock
methods.description: Preprocesses block templates, specifically for user provider blocks.
